sloka: स एवमुक्तो हतदर्पहर्षो निकृत्तचापः स हताश्वसूतः ।शरार्दितः कृत्तमहाकिरीटो विवेश लङ्कां सहसा स राजा ।। ६.५९.१४५ ।।।।
transliteration: sa evamukto hatadarpaharṣo nikṛttacāpaḥ sa hatāśvasūtaḥ ।śarārditaḥ kṛttamahākirīṭo viveśa laṅkāṁ sahasā sa rājā ।। 6.59.145 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken in that way (consoling), the king with his vanity and pride crushed, bow broken into pieces, horses and charioteer killed, wounded by arrows, crown broken entered Lanka hastily.
